title: Your page ready in 7 days. You decide after you see it.
intro: One package, no fine print. I build a free first draft of your business, you approve it, and only then do you pay.
founding_note: One-time payment. In exchange I ask for an honest review and permission to show your page.
founding_spots: 5 spots. I have not taken any yet.
regular_note: One-time payment. Applies after the first 5 clients.
included_1_body: Built for the phone first, fast, with your services, your hours and your area.
included_2_body: It takes every inquiry, replies in Spanish or English, and alerts you by text or email.
included_3_body: A short guide in Spanish and English so your team knows what to do when a customer comes in.
included_4_body: Domain, page and accounts are yours. If you ever want to leave, you take it all with you.
pay_1_body: I build the first version of your own business. You pay nothing to see it.
pay_2_body: If you do not like it, you owe me nothing. If you do, we move to the next step.
pay_3_body: The deposit is paid only after you approve the draft. The balance is due the day your page goes live.
addon_1_body: A fuller guide, tailored to your business.
addon_2_body: A brief clip that explains your service, ready for your page and social media.
addon_3_body: I handle changes, tweaks and keeping everything running. Optional, cancel any time.
honest_note: I am taking my first 5 clients and I do not have reviews yet. That is why you only pay after you approve.
cta: See your page before you pay
cta_note: Free draft in 48 hours. $0 until you approve it.
today_note: You see your draft first. The $100 deposit only comes if you approve it.
